title: Scoped PRD: Conditional SSO/SAML + Adaptive RBAC + KMS/HSM Evidence Pipeline
creator: Asha Patel
description: High-level PRD for shipping a combined feature set targeting enterprise Private/VPC customers: 1) conditional SSO/SAML integration with support for conditional access attributes (IP, device posture) and SAML response constraints; 2) adaptive RBAC model to support time-bound elevated roles and operator intent logging; 3) tightly integrated KMS + optional HSM attestation flow for customer key envelope encryption; 4) an automated evidence pipeline that bundles immutable audit artifacts for third-party auditors and customer compliance reviews. This ticket scopes requirements, clarifies non-functional constraints, defines acceptance criteria, and enumerates sign-off steps and rollback criteria for the rollout to private deployments.
out_of_scope: new identity provider adapters beyond SAML/OIDC
building new HSM hardware integrations (we will rely on partner HSM drivers)
requirements_summary: SSO/SAML: support SAML 2.0 SP-initiated flows, assertion validation with audience restriction, encrypted assertions, and conditional access enforcement based on IP and device posture signals.
RBAC: allow time-limited elevation grants (max 1 hour) with just-in-time approval flows; role change events must be immutably recorded to audit store.
KMS/HSM: support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) via envelope encryption; HSM attestation metadata must be captured and bound to the key-version record.

Audit & Evidence: create an append-only audit ledger for critical events (authn, authz changes, key ops, operator actions) and export packaged evidence bundles that include checksums, sigs, and chain-of-custody metadata.
Operator Runbooks: define automated and manual playbooks for key rotation, emergency key revocation, and SSO provider failover with clear rollback criteria.
Compatibility: features must be deployable to both Private (VPC) and On-prem (air-gapped) variants with operator-facing toggles for telemetry level and evidence export cadence.
non_functional_requirements: Audit retention: default 1 year, configurable to 7 years for enterprise tenants.
Latency: authn verification path must add <50ms p95 to typical token exchange in Dedicated deployments.
Reliability: key ops must meet 99.95% availability SLA in Dedicated offering.
Security: all evidence bundles must be signed with the cluster signing key and optionally encrypted with the customer's KMS key.
acceptance_criteria: Automated integration test that simulates SP-initiated SAML flow with conditional access attributes and verifies assertion rejection/acceptance based on IP predicate.
RBAC: ability to grant a time-bound elevation via UI or API; logs show the exact grant, approver, TTL, and auto-expiration event in the append-only ledger.
KMS/HSM: create-key flow for a BYOK customer stores HSM attestation metadata and the exported evidence contains the attestation digest and timestamp.
Evidence bundle generation: for a 30-day window, the evidence export contains all required events, tamper-proof checksums, and a signed manifest; verification script validates signature chain.
Operator runbook validation: run the emergency revocation playbook in a staging environment; keys are revoked and dependent compute falls back to fallback model variant without data leakage.
Security signoff: red-team review completes with no critical findings, and SRE approves performance regressions are within the NFR limits.
sign_off_checklist: PM sign-off on scope and acceptance criteria
Engineering sign-off on test coverage and rollback plan (link to GH PRs)
Design sign-off on UI changes (elevation flows and telemetry toggles)
Security review completed and mitigation ticketed for medium/low findings
Legal/compliance sign-off for evidence retention settings
Customer success checklist for on-prem upgrade guidance and operator training materials
rollback_criteria: If >0.5% of production authn requests start failing within 30 minutes of rollout, initiate automatic immediate rollback.
If evidence bundle generation fails to produce verifiable manifests in two consecutive runs, pause rollout and revert the export pipeline change.
If HSM-attested key unwrap error rate increases by >2x baseline for 15 minutes, rollback KMS client change and failover to software-wrapped keys.
metrics_and_slo_checks: Evidence export verification pass rate 100% in staging, >=99.9% in Dedicated
Audit append latency < 200ms for critical events
